compute.scope: CPU recurrent simulation; isolated neural-graft fitting uses a probed PyTorch accelerator when available and retries on CPU if needed

sources.source_selection: all proofread v783 neuron IDs; all released pairs >=1 synapse, retained per neuropil
sources.sampling: seeded role-stratified selection from highest-degree 4N candidate pool; induced edges
sources.weight_conversion: Anatomical counts and assumed transmitter signs supplied to graftbrain.build; frozen base weights use signed log1p counts, incoming row normalization and its configured gain (default 1.1).
sources.prior_weight_conversion: ACh +1; GABA -1; glutamate -1 assumes inhibitory GluCl; histamine -1; monoamines and unknown transmitters 0 (no fast signed efficacy inferred). Counts are converted with log1p and incoming absolute row sums bounded to 0.9; these are model parameters, not measured physiological efficacies.

online_rl is a legacy arm name: updates are reward-modulated Hebbian plasticity, not a new policy-gradient baseline.
adaptation_speed stores mean post-stage return; no time-to-mastery or negative-transfer control is measured.
Finite development tasks and seeds do not establish a general continual-learning advantage.
